title: Inside the NFL game management world tasked with preventing snafus like Commanders just had: 'It's irresponsible not to learn from others' mistakes'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Inside the NFL game management world tasked with preventing snafus like Commanders just had: 'It's irresponsible not to learn from others' mistakes'
sources.description: Game-management coordinators typically speak more on the gameday headset than their position-coach colleagues. But it's not an exact science, as the Commanders showed.
